description: Every catalog action through its real entrypoint (effective shortcut via debug.key, else action.run), input to committed frame from the action.perform and action.commit signposts, light session, shard 1 of 8 of the action ids by id hash (every-action-sweep.py --shard 1/8). Nightly (T2): the whole sweep is about 5 h of host time, more than T1's 2 h rounds hold; shard 1 also times the non-catalog interactions in its own report.
